1. Licenses/restrictions placed on the data: 

	Image data within this collection are usable under Creative Commons* licenses. The specific license versions for each dataset are listed in the document "00_Documentation/all_licenses_refs.csv" and the full terms and conditions of each license are available in "00_Documentation/licenses".  

	The metadata and models are provided in this repository are available for reuse without restriction under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 License (CC-BY-4.0)**. 

	*https://creativecommons.org/
